Project Role : LLM Full Stack Engineer


Project Role Description : Develop and integrate applications with Large Language Models (LLMs) and other enterprise services. Leverage front-end and server-side technologies to develop APIs, implement DevOps practices, and optimize Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications.


Must have skills : Machine Learning (ML)


Good to have skills : NA
Minimum
3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education


Summary:
As a Large Language Model Full Stack Engineer, a typical day involves designing and building applications that seamlessly integrate with advanced language models and various enterprise systems. The role requires balancing front-end and back-end development tasks, creating robust application programming interfaces, and ensuring smooth deployment through continuous integration and delivery practices. The engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams to enhance the performance and scalability of artificial intelligence solutions, while continuously refining the user experience and operational efficiency of the deployed applications.


Roles & Responsibilities:

Expected to perform independently and become an SME.

Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.

Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.

Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Maintain and improve existing applications by identifying bottlenecks and implementing optimizations.

Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and assisting in problem-solving.

Ensure adherence to best practices in coding, testing, and deployment to maintain high-quality deliverables.


Professional & Technical Skills:


Must To Have Skills:

Proficiency in Machine Learning (ML).

Experience with developing and integrating APIs to connect front-end and back-end systems.

Familiarity with DevOps methodologies and tools to automate deployment and monitoring processes.

Strong understanding of artificial intelligence application development and optimization.

Ability to work with both server-side and client-side technologies to deliver full stack solutions.

The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Machine Learning (ML).

This position is based at our Mumbai office.

A 15 years full time education is required.


Qualification 15 years full time education
